text: The four elements—earth, water, fire, and air—are distinct from one another due to the peculiar cause of their relative and absolute relations, and they are objects of mental modifications. These relations are of two kinds: those produced by direction and those produced by time. In a distant object, the relation of otherness is produced by direction; in a near object, the relation of non-otherness is produced by direction. In an elder, the relation of otherness is produced by time; in a younger, the relation of non-otherness is produced by time. || 29 ||
